taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The provider reports a detected violent-policy trigger routed to human review, demonstrating activation of that bounded review control.
Human review produced an operative first-account ban for policy violations; this activation is distinct from the disputed referral decision.
The account ban concretely restricted the detected account. This is the reported account-level protective effect, not proof of whole-event prevention or repeat-account detection.
Contemporaneous applicability/threshold is disputed; internal reviewer records are absent. Neither required non-activation nor a successful referral is established.
No authenticated inferential signal and consequential authority use is established.

OpenAI confirms that its repeat-policy-violator system did not identify the second account before the perpetrator’s identity became public, but the public record does not show whether that account or its linking signals were within required monitoring coverage.

The reported miss and planned strengthening may indicate insufficient protective effect, but the public record does not show whether the applicable repeat-account control became operative on available matching signals or what effect it was designed to provide.

source_evidence_limits: G01: FC-083’s sufficient-protection/independent-downstream-mechanism exclusion overlaps the account-scoped positive finding. Preserve that finding; no claim that the ban prevented the attack.

Referral applicability remains disputed between provider and plaintiffs. Later policy cannot define the earlier trigger retroactively. FC-023 needs actual repeat-account coverage and matching signals; a missed account alone does not establish them. FC-046 needs a specific inference-to-authority conversion, not unproduced alleged chat assistance. Separate human Discord criminal allegations are not AI output.

screen_outcome.v081_resolution: Only failure-oriented not-aligned exclusions do not displace independently established successful-invariant recognition; no established all-results exclusion remains on these roles.
